newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST - Nokia 1996 profit seen lower.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Nokia 1996 profit seen lower.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 3,851 million markka median forecast for telecommunications group Nokia Oy's full-year 1996 profit before tax and minority interest.
Profit before tax, minority interest EPS
(Profit forecast by 26 analysts, EPS by 24 analysts). @
Nokia's results are due on February 13 at around 1300/1100 GMT.
In 1995, Nokia had a 4,933 million markka profit before tax and minority interest.

Sixteen of the 26 analysts polled also gave forecasts for Nokia's dividend for 1996 with the median at 3.40 markka (mean 3.30 markka) in a 2.50 to 4.00 markka range. The dividend for 1995 was 3.00 markka.
For the company's full-year 1997 profit, 24 of the 26 analysts polled gave a median forecast of 6,015 million markka (mean 5,887 million) in a 4,100-6,972 million markka range. @

Contributors to the survey were Alfred Berg, AG Private Bankers, Aktia Bank, Aros Securities, BZW Securities, Carnegie Securities, Daiwa Europe, Den Danske Bank, Evli Securities, FIM Securities, FSB Securities, Goldman Sachs, Handelsbanken, Interbank, Kleinwort Benson Securities, Lehman Brothers, Merita Securities, Morgan Stanley, Opstock, Paribas, Postipankki, S-E Banken, Schroder Securities, Erik Selin, SBC Warburg and Williams de Broe.
